configuration.event_delivery: same JSONL event stream in both modes
configuration.timed_interval: first order publication through worker exit; includes event delivery and, when enabled, persistence queueing and final shutdown flush; excludes database setup, worker startup, warm-up, reconciliation, and cleanup
configuration.end_to_end_latency: worker perf_counter_ns timestamp after order processing minus producer perf_counter_ns timestamp immediately before the first ring-buffer write; includes producer backpressure and IPC wait
configuration.throughput: submitted orders divided by timed end-to-end duration

limitations: Results depend on machine load, OS scheduling, filesystem cache, SQLite configuration, and interpreter overhead.
The active engine may use the Python fallback; no native Cython compilation was attempted.
Event-stream serialization and file writes are included equally in both measured modes.
Warm-up and measured runs use fresh worker processes and fresh per-run databases.
